Draft a professional project-status email to Marcus Johnson at Beta Solutions regarding the Alpha Platform Migration handoff.

- Structure as a standard business email with appropriate subject line, salutation, body paragraphs, and closing.

answer:
**Subject:** Alpha Platform Migration — Project Status Update

Dear Marcus,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to provide you with an update on the Alpha Platform Migration project.

As of today, the project remains active under my ownership. Phase 1 (Discovery) was completed on May 31, 2026, with all deliverables—including stakeholder interviews, current state analysis, and requirements documentation—successfully finalized. We are currently in Phase 2 (Design), which runs through August 31, 2026. The UI/UX mockups are currently in progress, and the technical architecture work is pending. The Design Freeze milestone is scheduled for August 31, 2026.

Looking ahead, Phase 3 (Implementation) is planned to commence on September 1, 2026, with the Alpha Launch milestone targeted for March 15, 2027.

Information currently unavailable:
- The specific nature of Beta Solutions' involvement or responsibilities related to this project
- Details regarding any handoff arrangements, transition plans, or deliverables to be transferred to your team
- Specific discussion history or prior agreements between us regarding this engagement

If you could clarify the scope of your expected involvement and any specific handoff requirements you may have, I would be happy to ensure the appropriate information and materials are prepared for you.

Please feel free to reach me at your earliest convenience to discuss next steps.

Best regards,
Alice
